notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Reject invalid billing input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors with codes like "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" and "negative_amount", passing repr() of the offending value as detail.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0004] Guard mutations with the draft status check: Before mutating an invoice, check invoice.status != "draft" and raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}"), matching issue_invoice in ledgerly/invoice.py.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

item.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
item.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `subscriptions.current_period`).
